title: Supplementary code for: Voronoi Cells of Unit-Ball Packings in Dimension Four and the Twenty-Four-Cell Conjecture
description: Scripts, certificates, run logs and Lean 4 verifications supporting the paper. The package contains the exact chamber certificates of the single-deviation bound, the covering bound at every contact count, the root-system meets and the 600-cell enumeration, the slack continuation, and the three-point semidefinite certificate for the twenty-three-contact case together with its verification in exact rational arithmetic, interval arithmetic and Lean 4.
